# Gaia GPS

> Gaia GPS is a comprehensive outdoor navigation and mapping platform that combines topographic maps, trail finding, and adventure planning tools for hikers and outdoor enthusiasts.

Gaia GPS provides digital maps, trail discovery, and navigation features for outdoor recreation across major national parks and wilderness areas. The platform serves both individual adventurers and professional teams including search and rescue, firefighters, and land managers.

## Key Topics

- Trail finder
- Topographic maps
- Satellite maps
- National parks
- Hiking routes
- Offroad trails
- Map catalog
- Outdoor recreation
- Location search
- Geographic coverage
- Emergency response
- GIS tools
- Outside+ membership
- Yosemite National Park
- Yellowstone National Park

## Core Navigation & Mapping

- [Find Trails](https://www.gaiagps.com/hike): Trail finder for hiking routes across national parks and outdoor locations
- [Map Catalog](https://www.gaiagps.com/maps): Catalog of topographic, satellite, and adventure maps from USGS and Gaia

## Memberships & Plans

- [Gaia GPS Membership with Outside+](https://www.gaiagps.com/outsideplus): Outside+ membership combining Gaia GPS maps with outdoor content and education

## Professional & Enterprise Solutions

- [GIS App for Search and Rescue, Firefighters, and Land Managers](https://www.gaiagps.com/team): Team management and enterprise GIS features for professional outdoor users
- [Gaia GPS for Emergency Responders](https://www.gaiagps.com/emergency-response): Gaia GPS solutions for search and rescue and emergency response teams

## Community & Content

- [Gaia GPS Blog](https://blog.gaiagps.com): Blog with hiking guides, trip reports, and navigation tips for outdoor adventures

## Optional

- [Out and Back Podcast](https://www.gaiagps.com/outandback): Podcast featuring long-distance hikers and backcountry athletes
- [Careers](https://www.gaiagps.com/company/jobs): Careers and job opportunities at Outside Inc., parent company of Gaia GPS
- [Diversity, Equity & Inclusion](https://www.gaiagps.com/company/dei): Diversity, equity, and inclusion commitments and partnerships
